name: B10-0130/2026 (PPE) – Systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran's government to stop killing and arresting protesters, halt executions, and release everyone held for speaking out or for their faith. It asks for an end to torture, poor prison conditions and rapid trials without proper legal defence. It also demands the release of foreign and EU citizens held in Iran, and asks the European Union to press Iran harder with sanctions and to support independent checks of abuses.

- The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.
- It targets Iran's government, and EU bodies asked to add sanctions.
- Next: the resolution is sent to EU institutions and Iran's president.
